title: Make the release workflow publish through a reviewed pull request instead of pushing its version-bump commit straight to main
description: Found while fixing catalyst-v2-2xy (2026-10-11). .github/workflows/release.yml commits a version bump (pyproject version, CHANGELOG, README references) and then runs 'git push origin HEAD <tag>', so the bump commit lands on main without a pull request, required checks or the merge guard, and the tag points at that unreviewed commit rather than the CI-green commit the release gate checked. Acceptance: no release path writes to main directly; the version bump goes through a PR that passes the required checks and safe-merge (or the release tags the already-green merged commit and records the version without a new commit); tests pin it. Blocks any real release, alongside the GATE on green CI from catalyst-v2-2xy.

title: Make the release workflow stop on failing tests instead of swallowing them with || true
description: Release-blocking: the readiness step in .github/workflows/release.yml runs make test, npm test, python -m pytest, cargo test and go test each followed by '|| true', so a failing test does not stop tagging, pushing or publishing. Acceptance for the later fix: an applicable required-check failure prevents tagging, pushing and release publication. A green dry run is not evidence that failing tests block release. Blocks any real release; does not block the 1A compatibility work. Separate from handoff 1A.
notes: One authorized dry run on 2026-10-09: run 38002436987, ref main 110bfad, inputs dry_run=true bump=auto. Result success; tag/push and GitHub Release steps skipped by their dry_run guards; remote branches, tags and releases identical before and after (git ls-remote and gh release list diffed). The readiness step printed 'No test runner detected, skipping', so the || true path was not exercised: the green dry run is not evidence that failing tests block release. Remote-write paths found: git push origin HEAD tag and gh release create, both guarded by dry_run != 'true'.
close_reason: Fixed in PR #18, merged as ef17aa6 via safe-merge (CI run 38118250313 green). release.yml no longer runs tests with || true; a new step runs scripts/require_green_ci.py before any version, tag, push or publish step and fails closed unless both required CI checks succeeded on the release commit. Evidence: 18 tests in tests/test_release_gate.py (mutation: always-pass gate fails 9). Live refusal: dry-run run 38118219016 attempt 1 on 09ff102 with no CI, gate failed and every later step was skipped. Live pass: run 38118533205 on the same commit after green CI, with remote tags, releases and branches unchanged. The follow-up direct push to main is filed as catalyst-v2-oyu (P1).
